image_description: A cylindrical, brass-cased marine-style barometer and hygrometer combination instrument. The top features a circular dial with a glass cover, displaying atmospheric pressure readings with a black pointer and numerical scale. Below the main dial is a rectangular panel, also with a glass cover, displaying humidity levels (hygrometer) with a separate pointer and decorative weather icons. The casing has a polished gold/brass finish with riveted flanges at the top and bottom.
